scenarioStory.history: G2P1 at 39 weeks gestation. Labor started about 90 minutes ago and progressed unusually fast for her second pregnancy. Contractions are now less than 2 minutes apart and she reports an overwhelming urge to push and a feeling that the baby is coming now.
scenarioStory.course: Initial Contact: Crew arrives to find a 29-year-old G2P1 female at 39 weeks with crowning visible and strong, frequent contractions. Delivery is clearly imminent. → Controlled delivery performed: Crew supports the infant's head with gentle counterpressure to prevent explosive delivery, checks for a nuchal cord, and guides delivery of the anterior and posterior shoulders. → Newborn dried, warmed, and scored: Newborn delivers with a strong cry and good tone. Crew dries, warms, and stimulates the infant, delays cord clamping appropriately, and calculates APGAR scores at 1 and 5 minutes.

patientInformation.patientCondition: 39 weeks pregnant, strong urge to push, contractions very close together

scenarioEvents.name: Initial Contact
scenarioEvents.description: Crew arrives to find a 29-year-old G2P1 female at 39 weeks with crowning visible and strong, frequent contractions. Delivery is clearly imminent.

scenarioEvents.name: Controlled delivery performed
scenarioEvents.description: Crew supports the infant's head with gentle counterpressure to prevent explosive delivery, checks for a nuchal cord, and guides delivery of the anterior and posterior shoulders.
relatedChecklist: Support head with gentle counterpressure for slow, controlled delivery
Check for nuchal cord after head delivers; slip over head if present
Guide head down for anterior shoulder, then up for posterior shoulder

scenarioEvents.name: Newborn dried, warmed, and scored
scenarioEvents.description: Newborn delivers with a strong cry and good tone. Crew dries, warms, and stimulates the infant, delays cord clamping appropriately, and calculates APGAR scores at 1 and 5 minutes.
relatedChecklist: Do not routinely suction infant's airway, even with bulb syringe
Clamp cord in two places about 5-6 inches from abdomen after 1 minute; cut between clamps
Dry, warm, and stimulate infant; wrap in towel and place on maternal chest
Calculate APGAR score at 1 and 5 minutes
